methodologyNotes: The 9 most-compared Workforce Management tools, ranked by entry price. Each vendor's cheapest published self-serve plan, free tier, and compliance posture is sourced verbatim from the vendor's own pricing page (or a dated corroboration) — quote-only tiers are marked, never guessed.

vendors.name: Deputy

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: $5 per user per month (USD, excl. taxes), billed upfront or in monthly installments; includes basic scheduling, timesheets, and time clocking. USD $30/month minimum spend per invoice applies on monthly plans.

vendors.provenance: Re-fetched the Deputy pricing page (https://www.deputy.com/pricing) via fetch-clean.mjs on 2026-07-10. It shows three self-serve plans in USD: Lite at $5, Core at $6.50, and Pro at $9, each stated verbatim as "per user per month (USD excl. all applicable taxes)" and "billed upfront or in monthly installments". Lite is the lowest paid tier ("Everything you need to get started with scheduling and time tracking"). A FAQ on the same page confirms a minimum monthly spend of USD $30 per invoice on monthly Lite/Core/Pro plans. Only a free trial ("Start free trial"), no $0-forever plan, so freeTier=false. No HIPAA or SOC2 statement appears on the page, so both nulled. "Deputy Payroll enabled by Paycor" confirms the Paycor integration. Correct vendor (Deputy Corporation, workforce management: scheduling + time tracking). All fields verified against the live page.

vendors.name: Connecteam

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Operations Hub Basic ("Kick-start with the essentials"): flat $35/mo billed monthly for the first 30 users (or $29/mo equivalent billed yearly), then $1.0/user/mo above 30 on monthly Basic ($0.8/user/mo on yearly). Includes real-time GPS clock in/out, unlimited jobs, payroll integration, basic scheduling incl. open shifts, unlimited checklists/forms/tasks. Communications and HR & Skills Hubs each have their own Basic at $35/mo monthly with lower per-user overage.

vendors.provenance: Re-fetched https://connecteam.com/pricing/ via the clean-fetch script (fetch-clean.mjs). The page lists three hubs (Operations, Communications, HR & Skills), each with Basic/Advanced/Expert/Enterprise plans plus a free Limited tier. The lowest paid plan on the Operations Hub, Basic ("Kick-start with the essentials"), shows VERBATIM "$35 /mo — For the first 30 users — $1.0 / month for each additional user" (billed monthly) and "$29 /mo ... $0.8 / month for each additional user" (billed yearly). Confirmed this is Connecteam's own product/pricing page, not a sibling. Both a VERBATIM sourced price and freeTier===true survive, so publish=true.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $44.99/month (monthly-billed; $39.99/month billed annually). Unlimited locations, 30 employees per location; advanced scheduling, team communication, labor cost controls & budgeting, basic time clocking, permissions.

vendors.provenance: Re-fetched both pages via fetch-clean.mjs. The 7shifts pricing page (https://www.7shifts.com/pricing/) is JS-rendered and self-describes as a "Restaurant Scheduling and Payroll Platform" with a restaurant-type "Built For" list (confirms correct vendor, not a sibling), but exposes NO USD price figures in its text. Because prices are hidden behind JS, verification relied on the corroboration: Connecteam's "Honest 7shifts Review" (https://connecteam.com/reviews/7shifts/), updated July 2, 2026, which carries a verbatim June 2026 pricing table: Comp (Free), Essentials $44.99/month ($39.99/month billed annually), Pro $89.99/month, Premium $149.99/month. This confirms VERBATIM the lowest self-serve paid plan (Essentials) at $44.99/month monthly-billed, plus a genuinely free Comp plan (1 location, 15 employees/location). Essentials feature/limit claims all match the table (unlimited locations, 30 employees/location, advanced scheduling, team communication, labor cost controls & budgeting, basic time clocking, permissions). The same review names payroll integrations ADP, Gusto, Paychex, and QuickBooks Online. hipaa=null: no HIPAA statement on either page (security section lists MFA, RBAC, TLS, AES-256, PCI-DSS, IEC 27001, ISO, SOC only). soc2=null: only a vague "Service Organizations Controls (SOC)" mention, never explicitly "SOC 2". Both a verbatim sourced price and freeTier===true survive, so publish=true.

Rippling's own pricing page is quote-only and publishes no USD figures; this $8 PEPM figure comes from the review, not from Rippling directly. No free trial.
